A bent leg stance with target hip/knee/ankle angles near `−0.38 / 0.65 / −0.25` kept the robot upright. I’ll start with both arms spread so they cover the ball’s path.

const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Limited-mode H1 basketball controller.
+
+Run with ``python /app/output/gen.py [attempt]`` while the robot service is up.
+The controller uses only room-camera pixels, proprioception, and the pelvis IMU.
+It leaves episode grading and resets to the service.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import EpisodeOver, Robot
+
+
+def ball_center(rgb):
+    """Return the orange ball centroid in room-camera pixels, or None."""
+    a = np.asarray(rgb)
+    r, g, b = a[..., 0], a[..., 1], a[..., 2]
+    mask = (r > 145) & (g > 45) & (g < 180) & (b < 105) & (r > 1.35 * g) & (g > 1.2 * b)
+    y, x = np.nonzero(mask)
+    if len(x) < 8:
+        return None
+    return float(x.mean()), float(y.mean()), int(len(x))
+
+
+def targets_for(obs, attempt, ball):
+    """Build one balanced reaching target in radians."""
+    q = list(obs["proprio"]["joint_pos"])
+
+    # A compact, slightly crouched stance that stayed upright during the first reach.
+    for i, v in ((2, -0.38), (3, 0.65), (4, -0.25),
+                 (7, -0.38), (8, 0.65), (9, -0.25), (10, 0.0)):
+        q[i] = v
+
+    # Different attempts cover the incoming path at different heights and widths.
+    configs = (
+        (-1.48, 0.82, -0.82, -0.95),
+        (-1.38, 1.05, -1.05, -0.80),
+        (-1.62, 0.62, -0.62, -1.10),
+        (-1.25, 0.92, -0.92, -0.70),
+    )
+    pitch, left_roll, right_roll, elbow = configs[attempt % len(configs)]
+    if ball is not None:
+        cx, cy, _ = ball
+        # The room view shows the ball crossing from the robot's right to its left.
+        if cx < 235:
+            right_roll = min(right_roll, -0.95)
+        elif cx > 245:
+            left_roll = max(left_roll, 0.95)
+        # As the ball gets closer and lower in the room view, lower the hands.
+        pitch += max(-0.1, min(0.5, (cy - 132.0) * 0.025))
+        elbow += max(-0.1, min(0.35, (cy - 132.0) * 0.018))
+
+    q[11], q[12], q[13], q[14] = pitch, left_roll, 0.0, elbow
+    q[15], q[16], q[17], q[18] = pitch, right_roll, 0.0, elbow
+    return q
+
+
+def as_action(q, ranges):
+    out = []
+    for value, (lo, hi) in zip(q, ranges):
+        value = min(hi, max(lo, value))
+        out.append(2.0 * (value - lo) / (hi - lo) - 1.0)
+    return out
+
+
+def main():
+    attempt = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 0
+    robot = Robot()
+    spec = robot.spec()
+    ranges = spec["qpos"]["range"]
+    obs = robot.observe(images=False)
+    if obs["done"]:
+        obs = robot.reset(images=False)
+
+    print(f"episode start step={obs['step']} resets_left={obs['resets_left']} attempt={attempt}", flush=True)
+    last_ball = None
+    seen_ball = 0
+    missing_near = 0
+
+    while not obs["done"]:
+        image_obs = robot.observe(images=["room_camera"])
+        ball = ball_center(image_obs["images"]["room_camera"])
+        if ball is not None:
+            last_ball = ball
+            seen_ball += 1
+            missing_near = 0
+        elif seen_ball >= 2 and last_ball is not None and last_ball[1] > 125:
+            missing_near += 1
+
+        q = targets_for(image_obs, attempt, ball if ball is not None else last_ball)
+        action = as_action(q, ranges)
+        # Small batches preserve feedback during the fast incoming-ball phase.
+        try:
+            obs = robot.step("qpos", [action] * 5, images=["room_camera"])
+        except EpisodeOver:
+            obs = robot.status()
+            break
+
+        next_ball = ball_center(obs["images"]["room_camera"]) if "images" in obs else None
+        if next_ball is not None:
+            last_ball = next_ball
+            seen_ball += 1
+            missing_near = 0
+        elif seen_ball >= 2 and last_ball is not None and last_ball[1] > 125:
+            missing_near += 1
+
+        print(
+            f"step={obs['step']} done={obs['done']} reason={obs['reason']} "
+            f"ball={next_ball} imu={obs.get('imu')}", flush=True
+        )
+
+        if obs["done"]:
+            break
+
+        # After the ball has passed the hands, make a forward/upward two-arm push.
+        # The transition is delayed a few chunks so the raised arms can intercept it.
+        if seen_ball >= 2 and missing_near >= 2 and obs["step"] >= 20:
+            q = list(obs["proprio"]["joint_pos"])
+            for i, v in ((2, -0.38), (3, 0.65), (4, -0.25),
+                         (7, -0.38), (8, 0.65), (9, -0.25), (10, 0.0)):
+                q[i] = v
+            q[11], q[12], q[13], q[14] = -0.55, 0.25, 0.0, -0.10
+            q[15], q[16], q[17], q[18] = -0.55, -0.25, 0.0, -0.10
+            action = as_action(q, ranges)
+            obs = robot.step("qpos", [action] * 5, images=["room_camera"])
+            print(
+                f"push step={obs['step']} done={obs['done']} reason={obs['reason']} "
+                f"imu={obs.get('imu')}", flush=True
+            )
+            # Keep the feet and torso under position control while the ball travels.
+            while not obs["done"] and obs["step"] < spec["max_episode_steps"]:
+                q = list(obs["proprio"]["joint_pos"])
+                for i, v in ((2, -0.38), (3, 0.65), (4, -0.25),
+                             (7, -0.38), (8, 0.65), (9, -0.25), (10, 0.0)):
+                    q[i] = v
+                q[11], q[12], q[13], q[14] = -0.55, 0.25, 0.0, -0.10
+                q[15], q[16], q[17], q[18] = -0.55, -0.25, 0.0, -0.10
+                action = as_action(q, ranges)
+                obs = robot.step("qpos", [action] * 5, images=["room_camera"])
+                b = ball_center(obs["images"]["room_camera"]) if "images" in obs else None
+                print(f"travel step={obs['step']} done={obs['done']} ball={b}", flush=True)
+            break
+
+    print(f"episode end step={obs['step']} done={obs['done']} reason={obs['reason']} resets_left={obs['resets_left']}", flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";

const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Limited-mode H1 basketball controller.
+
+Run with ``python /app/output/gen.py`` while the robot service is up. The
+controller uses room-camera RGB, proprioception, and the pelvis IMU only. It
+keeps trying from the same start state until the service passes or denies a
+reset.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import EpisodeOver, Robot
+
+
+def ball_center(rgb):
+    """Return orange-ball centroid (x, y, area) in room-camera pixels."""
+    a = np.asarray(rgb)
+    r, g, b = a[..., 0], a[..., 1], a[..., 2]
+    mask = (r > 145) & (g > 45) & (g < 180) & (b < 105) & (r > 1.35 * g) & (g > 1.2 * b)
+    y, x = np.nonzero(mask)
+    if len(x) < 8:
+        return None
+    return float(x.mean()), float(y.mean()), int(len(x))
+
+
+def as_action(q, ranges):
+    return [2.0 * (min(hi, max(lo, value)) - lo) / (hi - lo) - 1.0
+            for value, (lo, hi) in zip(q, ranges)]
+
+
+def stance(q, jumping):
+    """Set a balanced, slightly crouched pose, or a short leg extension."""
+    if jumping:
+        values = ((2, -0.38), (3, -0.26), (4, 0.40),
+                  (7, -0.38), (8, -0.26), (9, 0.40))
+    else:
+        values = ((2, -0.38), (3, 0.65), (4, -0.25),
+                  (7, -0.38), (8, 0.65), (9, -0.25))
+    for i, value in values:
+        q[i] = value
+    q[10] = 0.0
+    return q
+
+
+def reach_targets(obs, attempt, ball):
+    q = list(obs["proprio"]["joint_pos"])
+    step = obs["step"]
+    jump_attempt = attempt % 4 == 3
+    jumping = jump_attempt and step < 11
+    stance(q, jumping)
+
+    if jump_attempt:
+        pitch, left_roll, right_roll, elbow = -2.87, 0.80, -0.80, -1.25
+    else:
+        configs = (
+            (-1.65, 0.25, -0.25, -1.10),
+            (-1.80, 0.10, -0.10, -1.20),
+            (-1.55, 0.40, -0.40, -0.95),
+            (-1.70, 0.00, 0.00, -1.10),
+        )
+        pitch, left_roll, right_roll, elbow = configs[attempt % len(configs)]
+
+    if ball is not None and not jump_attempt:
+        cx, cy, _ = ball
+        # Positive left roll moves that hand toward screen-left. Negative right
+        # roll moves its hand toward screen-right in the fixed room camera.
+        if cx < 222:
+            left_roll = max(left_roll, 0.85)
+        elif cx > 238:
+            right_roll = min(right_roll, -0.85)
+        # Lower the reach as the descending ball approaches the robot.
+        pitch += max(-0.1, min(0.35, (cy - 132.0) * 0.02))
+        elbow += max(-0.1, min(0.25, (cy - 132.0) * 0.015))
+
+    q[11], q[12], q[13], q[14] = pitch, left_roll, 0.0, elbow
+    q[15], q[16], q[17], q[18] = pitch, right_roll, 0.0, elbow
+    return q, jump_attempt
+
+
+def push_targets(obs, ranges):
+    """Sweep raised hands down and forward through the intercepted ball."""
+    q = list(obs["proprio"]["joint_pos"])
+    stance(q, jumping=False)
+    q[11], q[12], q[13], q[14] = -1.0, 0.2, 0.0, 0.5
+    q[15], q[16], q[17], q[18] = -1.0, -0.2, 0.0, 0.5
+    return as_action(q, ranges)
+
+
+def travel_targets(obs, ranges):
+    q = list(obs["proprio"]["joint_pos"])
+    stance(q, jumping=False)
+    q[11], q[12], q[13], q[14] = -1.0, 0.2, 0.0, 0.5
+    q[15], q[16], q[17], q[18] = -1.0, -0.2, 0.0, 0.5
+    return as_action(q, ranges)
+
+
+def drive_episode(robot, spec, attempt):
+    ranges = spec["qpos"]["range"]
+    obs = robot.observe(images=False)
+    seen = 0
+    last_ball = None
+    missing = 0
+    pushed = False
+    print(f"episode start step={obs['step']} attempt={attempt} resets_left={obs['resets_left']}", flush=True)
+
+    while not obs["done"]:
+        current = robot.observe(images=["room_camera"])
+        ball = ball_center(current["images"]["room_camera"])
+        if ball is not None:
+            seen += 1
+            last_ball = ball
+            missing = 0
+        elif last_ball is not None:
+            missing += 1
+
+        q, jump_attempt = reach_targets(current, attempt, ball or last_ball)
+        action = as_action(q, ranges)
+        try:
+            obs = robot.step("qpos", [action] * 5, images=["room_camera"])
+        except EpisodeOver:
+            obs = robot.status()
+            break
+
+        ball = ball_center(obs["images"]["room_camera"]) if "images" in obs else None
+        if ball is not None:
+            seen += 1
+            last_ball = ball
+            missing = 0
+        elif last_ball is not None:
+            missing += 1
+
+        print(f"step={obs['step']} ball={ball} done={obs['done']} reason={obs['reason']} "
+              f"imu={obs.get('imu')}", flush=True)
+        if obs["done"]:
+            break
+
+        # On the jumping attempt, start the push as the ball reaches the upper
+        # body. Other attempts push only after the near-body ball leaves view.
+        if not pushed and ((jump_attempt and obs["step"] >= 10) or
+                           (seen >= 2 and missing >= 2 and obs["step"] >= 15)):
+            obs = robot.step("qpos", [push_targets(obs, ranges)] * 3,
+                             images=["room_camera"])
+            pushed = True
+            print(f"push step={obs['step']} done={obs['done']} reason={obs['reason']} "
+                  f"imu={obs.get('imu')}", flush=True)
+
+            while not obs["done"] and obs["step"] < spec["max_episode_steps"]:
+                obs = robot.step("qpos", [travel_targets(obs, ranges)] * 5,
+                                 images=["room_camera"])
+                b = ball_center(obs["images"]["room_camera"])
+                print(f"travel step={obs['step']} ball={b} done={obs['done']} "
+                      f"reason={obs['reason']}", flush=True)
+            break
+
+    print(f"episode end step={obs['step']} done={obs['done']} reason={obs['reason']} "
+          f"resets_left={obs['resets_left']}", flush=True)
+    return obs
+
+
+def main():
+    robot = Robot()
+    spec = robot.spec()
+    obs = robot.observe(images=False)
+    attempt = 0
+    while True:
+        if obs["done"]:
+            if obs["reason"] == "success" or obs["resets_left"] <= 0:
+                break
+            obs = robot.reset(images=False)
+            attempt += 1
+        obs = drive_episode(robot, spec, attempt)
+    print(f"run end reason={obs['reason']} resets_left={obs['resets_left']}", flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
